changelog: Initial release. Shell-only port of OriginOS FCM Guardian (io.github.originosfcmguardian) privileged logic: GMS stopped-state detection & unstop (Android 13+), triple GCM heartbeat, per-boot one-shot auto recovery, target manager, vivo deep links, offline WebUI. Requires Shevery/Shizuku-Next with Full access + Allow background actions, shell uid 2000 only.
